trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task behind it: treat it as the finish line of the roadmap, not a trophy to chase on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Work the roadmap in order, S1 to S7, and tick each trophy off as it pops.
Leave the long grinds (stunts, WAiNK It, vehicles) for the S6 cleanup pass, when fast travel and the full map are open.
Check the tracker before the final session: any trophy still unticked is listed under Next up.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the mission Gone Fishing early in the game. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops at the results screen; nothing in it can be failed permanently, since missions can be replayed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the story until Gone Fishing appears, then follow the mission markers to the water.
Finish the fishing sequence the mission teaches you; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
If a cast goes wrong, retry from the last checkpoint rather than restarting the whole mission.
The trophy pops with the mission results screen; Gone Fishing also teaches fishing for the later Cal challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies like this one are unmissable: the chapter ends, the trophy pops. Use Chapter 1 to learn the map, start the meditation spots, and keep a manual save before the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1's missions in story order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
Before the final mission of the chapter, make a manual save — it protects the possibly missable meditation trophy later.
Meditate at any spots you pass in Chapter 1; each one counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable and pops the moment the chapter closes, so the only planning needed is to keep side content ticking along beside the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play Chapter 2's missions in story order until the chapter closes.
Between missions, try one new activity type so Master of None keeps filling in.
Note any new vehicle you drive; each new discovery counts toward Whip It Good.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophy pops at the close of the chapter, and by now the city is wide open, so it is a good moment to knock out the drone races and the first shooting-range medals between missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play Chapter 3's missions in story order until the chapter closes.
Use the gaps between missions for one Top Fun Drone Race location.
Try the Shooting Range when you pass it; gold medals there are the long grind of The Shootist.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end; the open city makes this the best chapter for side activities.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops, the endgame and the cleanup pass are all that remain between you and the platinum.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play Chapter 4's missions in story order until the chapter closes.
Check the Missables watch before the finale: anything flagged there should be done now, not after.
Stock up on ammo and armour before the final mission chain begins.

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. It is a gold trophy and unmissable: complete the story and it pops. Expect a long, multi-part finale, so go in with full health, armour and a stocked weapon wheel.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4, then follow the story markers into the final mission.
Play the finale in one sitting if you can; checkpoints carry you through its parts.
After the credits, free roam opens for the S5–S7 cleanup pass.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission trophy: play the mission to its end and it pops. The name hints at the mission's tone — a run with someone you are learning to trust — so expect driving and a conversation, not a shootout.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears on the map.
Follow the mission markers and finish the run; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Missions can be replayed, so a failed attempt costs nothing but time.
The trophy pops at the results screen; Breakfast Run also opens the partner activities used by later trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in this series are usually multi-part, with a setup phase and the job itself; the trophy pops when the job is done and the crew gets away.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks and run its setup missions first.
Complete the heist itself; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
Bring a fast getaway vehicle to the job — the escape is usually the hardest part.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission trophy that pops at the mission's end. The title suggests a job with family stakes, so expect the mission to mix driving, a set piece and a choice of approach.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play the story until Child's Play appears, then follow its markers.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
If the mission offers a stealth or loud approach, either one completes it.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; family missions like this one often hide collectibles nearby.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. The stylised title points to a big public set piece — the kind of mission that makes the news in-game — and the trophy pops when the mission is complete.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play the story until Headliners unlocks.
Complete the mission's set piece and escape; the trophy pops at the end.
Expect heavy police attention after a mission like this; plan the getaway route before you start.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. The trophy pops when the takedown is done; airport missions tend to be loud, with vehicles and open runways, so use cover and keep moving.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the takedown at the airport; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
Do not confuse this with Catch Me If You Can, the separate VCIA free-roam trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a military-style operation and a storm of a firefight; stock up, use cover, and let the mission's checkpoints carry you through its waves.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks in Chapter 4.
Complete the operation; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
Go in with full armour and a rifle with plenty of reserve ammo.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own stats screen. This is the last gold before the platinum for most players: it counts story, stranger missions, activities, collectibles and stunts, so it falls naturally at the end of the S7 cleanup pass. Watch the in-game percentage, not the trophy count, to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story and all stranger mission strands first; they are the biggest slice of the percentage.
Clear the activity and collectible sets in S6; each one moves the in-game percentage.
Open the stats screen after each session to see which category still holds the missing percent.
The trophy pops the moment the stats screen reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime, that kind of driving. It is a pure grind trophy, and the fastest way through it is to chain small stunts on busy highways rather than hunting one big jump at a time. It pairs naturally with the driving you already do between missions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Drive fast on highways and through traffic: near misses and airtime both count as stunts.
Find a jump you can repeat — a ramp or a crest — and loop it instead of roaming.
Watch the in-game stunt counter after each session so you know how many of the 250 are left.
The trophy pops at stunt 250; keep a fast car with good handling for the grind.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone racing and the rest. It is a tour of the side content, so start it early — the first time you pass an activity marker, stop and try it.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Whenever a new activity marker appears on the map, stop and try that activity once.
The checklist in this guide lists the activity types; tick each one as you try it.
Do not skip the quiet ones — meditation, bowling and arcade games count too.
The trophy pops when the last activity type is tried; the app's activity list shows which types remain.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest silver in the set: each challenge tests a weapon class against the clock, so it rewards a steady aim and a calm trigger finger more than fast reflexes. Work through them one weapon class at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit the Shooting Range and try every challenge once to learn its targets and par time.
Gold the easy weapon classes first — pistols and rifles — to learn the rhythm.
For the hard ones, slow down: a hit beats a fast miss, and the clock forgives accuracy.
All 42 challenges gold-medalled pops the trophy; the range keeps your best medal per challenge.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations around Leonida. Drone races are short, technical circuits through gates; learn one circuit's line before pushing for the win, and cut corners only where the gates allow it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find the Top Fun Drone Race markers and fly each course once to learn its gates.
Race each location until you win it; a win at a location is what counts.
Fly low and smooth — crashing costs more time than a cautious line ever does.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Races run across Leonida's roads, water and air, so vary the event and the vehicle class. A win counts when the event is a distinct race on the map.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Open the race list and pick events you have not won yet; each new win counts.
Use the fastest vehicle in the event's class — handling matters more than top speed on city circuits.
Retrying a lost race is free; learn the circuit's braking points before the next attempt.
The trophy pops at the 20th distinct race win.
Mix road, water and air races so the 20 wins come from across the map.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing game — hook the fish, then manage the line's tension while it fights — and Cal is the rival angler who sets the bar. The Gone Fishing mission teaches the basics; the challenge is where you prove them.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Finish Gone Fishing first so the fishing controls are second nature.
Find Cal's fishing challenge and accept it when your tackle is ready.
Reel steadily and ease off when the line strains; a snapped line loses the catch.

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end. Arcades are scattered around Leonida's malls and bars; any game's completion counts. Pick a short one first — the trophy is about finishing, not a high score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Find an arcade cabinet in a mall or bar and start any game.
Play it through to its ending screen; quitting early does not count.
Short games finish fastest — save the high-score chase for after the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands unlock across the map as you explore; each contact's missions build toward one last job, and this trophy pops when Andy's does.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Find Andy's stranger marker and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Stranger missions stay available in free roam, so none of them can be missed.
Andy's strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so it is two trophies for one playthrough.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Like the other stranger contacts, Kenton's jobs appear as you explore Leonida; work through them in order and the final mission closes the strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Find Kenton's stranger marker and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Boat missions reward a good boat — keep one moored nearby before you start.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's jobs lean toward the open road — the trophy's name says it — so expect riding, driving and long distances between stops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Find Billy's stranger marker and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Keep a fast bike ready: his missions suit two wheels better than four.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands. There are more than eight strangers in Leonida, so you can pick the eight whose missions you enjoy most — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them. The trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Play every stranger marker you find; each strand's missions unlock in order.
Finish the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — five of the eight.
Pick three more strangers from the map and finish their strands too.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand's final mission ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Randy's jobs are the supply-side of Leonida's underworld — moving product, meeting buyers — and the strand closes with one last delivery.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Find Randy's stranger marker and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Keep a sturdy vehicle with a big boot for the delivery runs.
Randy's strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's strand is the spin-off of the supply chain — fast, loud jobs — and its final mission closes the strand for good.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Find Tyrone's stranger marker and play his missions in order.
Complete his final mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
Expect a chase in the finale; a fast car with full health helps.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. This is the one trophy the sources flag as possibly missable, and the sources disagree on the count: PowerPyx lists 18 spots while other guides list 15. Do the spots as you find them, keep a manual save from Chapter 1, and treat 18 as the target until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Meditate at every spot you pass from Chapter 1 on — do not leave them for later.
PowerPyx lists 18 meditation spots; other guides list 15. Aim for 18 so either count is covered.
Keep a manual save from early Chapter 1; if a spot turns out to be chapter-locked, that save is your way back.
Use the tracker's meditation counter (18 spots) to see how many you still need.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind hunts: track the animal, get close without spooking it, and take a clean shot. Bret's request is the hunting strand's showcase, so expect a trek into the wilds of Leonida.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Find Bret and take the hunt; he marks the animal's territory on the map.
Track the animal quietly — approach from downwind and stay out of its sight line.
Take one clean shot; a wounded animal runs, and a long chase follows.
The trophy pops when Bret accepts the hunt; unique animals do not respawn, so make the shot count.

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, on ledges, in out-of-the-way corners — and a set is complete when every card in it is found. Three finished sets pop the silver.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Pick up every card you spot while doing other things; they add up fast.
Work one set at a time so you can see which cards in it are still missing.
Check shops and high ledges last — cards hide in both.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the game's photo-and-tag activity, done at a hundred distinct spots. It is a long, relaxed grind: the trick is to do it as you travel, tagging a spot every time you pass somewhere new, instead of saving all 100 for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: WAiNK It at every new location you visit from the start of the game.
Use the tracker counter: 100 locations is the target, and the app counts your progress.
Sweep the map region by region in the S6 cleanup pass for the spots you missed.
The trophy pops at the 100th distinct location.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small side goals — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats — and they tick over constantly while you play. Fifty of them is a natural mid-game milestone if you vary what you do.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Open the challenges list and pick off the easy ones first — driving and exploration.
Vary your play: each new kind of feat unlocks a new challenge to complete.
Check the challenge count after each session; 50 is the target.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. It is a co-op moment: the two of you against the whole of Leonida's police, ending in a clean getaway. Do it while the partner is available in the story, and keep a fast car ready.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Wait for a mission or free-roam moment when your partner is riding with you.
Cause chaos until the wanted level reaches 4 stars, then drive for open country.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
The trophy pops the moment the wanted level clears with your partner still beside you.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. It is a chain: hit one shop, move straight to the next, and keep the heat on. Plan a route through three nearby shops before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Pick three shops close together and plan the route between them.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then drive straight to the second — do not lose the cops in between.
Hit the third shop the same way; the trophy pops when the third robbery completes.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive them, and each new model counts. Leonida is full of cars, bikes, boats and aircraft, so the count grows fastest when you steal or borrow anything you have not driven before instead of sticking to one favourite.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Drive every new vehicle you see, even for a few seconds — discovery is what counts.
Visit car parks, docks and airfields: each holds models you will not find on the street.
The tracker shows your count toward 100; sweep the rare vehicles last.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-time aiming mode: trigger it in a crowded fight, line up headshots, and keep the chain going until the fifth enemy falls. Pick a mission or a shootout with plenty of targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Find a fight with at least five enemies in the open — a gang shootout works well.
Activate Combat Focus, then take the enemies down one by one before it runs out.
Headshots drop enemies fastest; do not waste the slow time on cover.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground without a flight plan. It is a free-roam stunt with a wink: find a plane on the tarmac, get in, and take off before airport security catches up with you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Head to VCIA and find a plane parked on the tarmac.
Get in and take off down the runway before security reaches you.
Once airborne, the trophy pops; land somewhere quiet afterwards.

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank — and enjoy it. The description is a joke about the heat of the thing; the trophy is about finding one of Leonida's tanks and taking it for a drive. Military bases and the right mission moments are where tanks turn up.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Find a Rhino tank — military areas are the surest bet.
Get in and drive it; the trophy pops once you are rolling in it.
Expect a wanted level: tanks attract attention, so enjoy the ride while it lasts.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without ever being detected. This is the stealth trophy: case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A loud robbery fails the condition, so patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Case the jewelry store first: note the cameras, the guards and the exits.
Go in quiet, take the goods, and leave without tripping an alarm.
If you are spotted, leave and come back another day — detection voids the attempt.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Bank vaults are the big-score robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, and escape the response. Five successful vault jobs pop the silver — the toughest crime trophy in the set.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Find the bank vault jobs and plan each one before you start it.
Crack the vault, take the cash, and escape clean — an escape after each job is what counts.
Use a fast getaway car parked close by, with a route already in mind.
The trophy pops after the fifth vault escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads; stop one, crack it open, grab the cash and get away before the response arrives. It is the small version of the bank-vault jobs, and a good rehearsal for them.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road and block it in.
Crack the truck, take the cash, and drive off before the police close in.
A quiet stretch of road beats a busy one — fewer witnesses, fewer cops.

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — the whole map, from Vice City's beaches to the swamps and the northern towns. The map fills in as you travel; the trophy pops when the last blank patch is uncovered. It is best finished in the cleanup pass, sweeping the map region by region.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Travel everywhere the story takes you; the map fills in as you go.
In the cleanup pass, sweep the map region by region for blank patches.
Boats and aircraft reach the corners roads never touch.
The trophy pops when the last region is uncovered.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own rackets — stash houses, labs, fronts — and this trophy wants one hit against each of them. It is a tour of the underworld as much as a robbery list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Learn which gangs hold territory in Leonida and where their operations sit.
Rob one illegal operation per gang, and get away clean each time.
Hit the well-guarded ones last, once your weapons and armour are at their best.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is the guide's breather trophy: find the right bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and watch the sun over the water. No chase, no wanted level — just Leonida at its best.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Head to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it; the trophy pops once the moment registers.
Do it early in Chapter 1 — it sets the tone for the whole game.
The trophy pops once the cocktail is served; it is the easiest bronze in the whole list.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the series' signature move, driving a car straight through the glass. Pick a showroom, pick a car, and floor it through the front window. The trophy pops on the way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Find a vehicle showroom with a big glass front.
Get in a car inside and drive it straight out through the glass.
Keep driving once you are out — the police will want a word about the window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there. Bowling is one of the game's quiet activities: pick up a ball, aim down the lane, and finish the game. It also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and start a game.
Bowl through the game to its end; the trophy pops when the game finishes.
A straight, gentle roll beats a fast hook when you are learning the lanes.

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the game's relationship system, grown until the two of you are a name people know. It is earned by spending time together and doing things as a pair, across missions and free roam alike.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Spend time with your partner across missions, activities and free roam.
Do things as a pair — robberies, races, quiet moments — to grow the partnership.
The trophy pops when the partnership reaches its top tier.

trophies.guide: Make a choice — for better or worse. This is a story-branch trophy: at some point the game asks you to choose, and either choice pops it. There is no wrong answer for the trophy, so pick the one that fits your playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Play the story until a choice is offered.
Make your choice; the trophy pops either way.
Choices like this are why a manual save before big story moments is worth keeping.

trophies.guide: Succeed on the second attempt at something that beat you the first time. The game's way of saying that failure is part of the story: fail an attempt at a challenge or a job, then come back and land it on the second try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Find a challenge or job you can retry — a race, a stunt, a timed task.
Fail the first attempt, then succeed on the second; the trophy pops on the success.
Do not force it: it comes naturally if you retry the things you miss.

trophies.guide: Stumble into something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters — the kind of moment that makes you stop and ask what just happened — and this trophy is for finding one. Explore the map's quiet corners and the trophy finds you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Explore Leonida's out-of-the-way places: swamps, back roads, empty beaches.
Look for anything out of place — a strange light, an odd structure, an unusual encounter.
The trophy pops when the strange moment triggers.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. It is a driving-combat trick: line the car up, swing as you pass, and keep rolling. Bowling alleys are not involved; the name is a pun.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get a melee weapon and a car, then find a target on foot.
Drive past and swing the weapon as you go by; the hit has to land from the moving vehicle.
A slow, straight pass is easier than a fast one — aim for the shoulders, not the wheels.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from jobs; contacts clean it for a cut. Run enough jobs, wash the take through your contacts, and the total climbs to a quarter of a million.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Take jobs that pay in Marked Bills and bank the dirty cash.
Launder the bills through your contacts a little at a time.
Keep laundering as you play; the trophy pops at $250,000 washed.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all the shops of Leonida. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every dollar spent anywhere counts toward the total. It comes naturally across a full playthrough, and big purchases like vehicles move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend as you play: weapons, ammo, clothes and car upgrades all count.
Buy a vehicle when the total stalls — big purchases close the gap fast.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are the safehouses for your vehicle collection: each one you buy adds storage and a place to keep the rare finds. Save up, then buy them one by one until none are left on the market.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Find the garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy them one by one as your cash allows.
The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is Leonida's ride-share for two wheels: register scooters and bikes you own or find, and the count climbs. Ten registered vehicles pop the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app and see which vehicles it accepts.
Register scooters and bikes you own or find around the city.
The trophy pops at the tenth registered vehicle.
Scooters are the easiest registrations — they are parked all over Vice City.
